props.title: Why Hot Tea Cools So Fast
props.subtitle: Three ways heat escapes your cup

scenes.narration: Ever wondered why your tea goes cold so quickly? Let's find out.

props.text: Heat always flows from hot to cold

scenes.narration: First, a simple rule: heat always flows from hot things to cold things.
Your tea loses heat three ways: steam off the top, warmth into the cup, and radiation into the room.

props.caption: Evaporation does most of the work in the first few minutes

scenes.narration: Evaporation is the big one. Each escaping molecule carries a lot of energy away.

props.quote: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
props.author: Marie Curie

scenes.narration: As Marie Curie put it, nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
Thanks for watching, and subscribe for more kitchen science.
